crossRefs.note: However there was no accounting made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt…
The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and…
I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man…
“Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due…
He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this…
He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in…
If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own…
Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

translations.web: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
translations.bsb: No accounting was required from the men who received the money to pay the workmen, because they acted with integrity.
translations.kjv: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
translations.asv: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to give to them that did the work; for they dealt faithfully.
